mechanism: Atazanavir is a CYP3A4 inhibitor that may increase irbesartan plasma concentrations, potentially enhancing hypotensive effects; irbesartan may also increase atazanavir levels through competitive CYP3A4 metabolism.
action: Monitor blood pressure regularly and renal function; dose adjustment of irbesartan may be necessary; ensure adequate hydration and counsel on orthostatic hypotension symptoms.
